title: TermSheet
description: Multi-issue term sheet carried in every binding Offer. Every issue carries {value, negotiable, status}. Reservation values never appear here. Issues not listed are fixed.

pricing_basis.description: Device/OS-based pricing is prohibited regardless of basis.

parties.description: Orderer, consignee and payer may differ.

mrp.description: From catalog price.maximum_value. Read-only, never negotiable.

retail_package_mrp_required.description: True for a retail package that must bear MRP: the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules r.18(2) ceiling (validator V-01) applies. False signals a Rule 3 exemption (industrial or institutional consumer packs, packages over 25 kg or 25 L). Fail-safe default until Q-20 is settled: in B2C, V-01 is checked on every line that carries an mrp, whatever this flag; false is honoured only in B2B; and mandatory packing and convenience charges count toward the MRP.

asserted_by_buyer.description: False for seller-added lines. A counter may not add unasserted lines (anti basket-sneaking).

code.description: What the charge is. These are charges the payer owes. The seller's own costs (merchant discount rate, payment aggregator commission, finder fee) are never charge codes.

payment_method_specific.description: The one payment handler this charge applies to. A charge with neither this nor applies_to_handlers applies to every handler. Use applies_to_handlers for a charge that applies to several handlers but not all.

applies_to_handlers.description: The payment handlers this charge applies to. A charge with neither this nor payment_method_specific applies to every handler. It MUST NOT appear together with payment_method_specific.

recipient.description: Who receives the charge from the payer's money, as the seller's side signed it. REQUIRED. The gateway never infers it from the charge code; for a charge that arrives over Beckn it applies the published title_type mapping of the Beckn binding.

refund_rule.description: Whether the charge is refunded on a cancellation or return: always, only before dispatch, or never. It MUST have been disclosed before the principal committed. A refund below the amount paid is lawful only for a charge disclosed as retained and only where the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 permit it.

first_disclosed_round.description: Round in which the fee first appeared. A fee first disclosed after round 1 forces re-consent.

all_in_total.description: Every mandatory charge incl. tax. REQUIRED from round 1. Must equal Beckn quote.price.

incoterm.description: FOR_DESTINATION is Indian domestic practice, not an Incoterm.

items.description: One payment alternative with its own all-in total, so COD vs prepaid prices are visible from round 1.

event.description: Beckn timing vocabulary plus acceptance events: GRN for MSMED, CRAC for GeM.

is_credit.description: True when goods/services move before this tranche is paid (trade credit).

deductible_from_final.description: Token/advance adjusted against the final amount.

apr_pct.description: Annual percentage rate including fees and charges, as required by the RBI Key Facts Statement rules; not the interest rate alone.

emi.description: Equated monthly instalments. no_cost MUST be false when interest_amount > 0.

deducted_at_source.description: e.g. arhtiya commission or interlocked loan repayment shown as a separate line.

linked_agreement_ref.description: e.g. registered RERA agreement for sale, required above 10%.

conditions_precedent.description: ICA s.6: offer lapses if a condition precedent fails.

extensions.description: Namespaced extra issues. Guards fail closed on any extension issue not in Agree.

fx.description: Foreign-currency view of a cross-border payment. Settlement stays INR: inr_total is an INR Amount = round(foreign_amount * rate * (1 + markup_bps/10000)).

conditional.description: Conditional/deferred cashback MUST NOT be counted in all_in_total.

allOf.description: MSMED Act s.15 cap: a manufacturing or services micro/small seller may not be given more than 45 days from acceptance or deemed acceptance. Whether traders are covered is open question Q-21.
An interest-bearing EMI cannot be described as no-cost.
